name: نادي زهرة الامل للسيدات - Zahrat Al Amal Ladies GYM
address: Al Khan - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: We Empower women to live a lifestyle of confidence, happiness, fitness and health

reviews.author: Shibila Nizar
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience at the gym. The facilities are top-notch, and I was particularly impressed with the body combat training. The coach Amal is excellent and provided great guidance throughout the sessions. I truly enjoy my time at the gym and I love my fitness journey here. Peace and love ✌🏻☮️

reviews.author: Zeeba Kalan
reviews.text: I’m in absolute love with the gym and my gym instructor- Amal. She’s full of energy, full of life and has this bright smile that’s so heartwarming. I joined to shape my body and to lose a bit of weight. I managed to achieve them both because of her constant push and regular classes. It’s been only 3 months. Apart from that, I love the place, the environment, the people that come here and technically, everything else. Everyone is so kind and giving. I enjoy every class, including our dance fever classes. The belly dancing classes with Maha are a plus point. I’d also like to add, I don’t see an improvement in my body only. I see a whole new person on an emotional and mental level. I couldn’t be more grateful! Love and light x ♥️✨

reviews.author: Parveen
reviews.text:
I absolutely love the atmosphere at this gym! It’s always positive, motivating, and full of friendly faces. The group of ladies here truly makes it special. I would never usually train in the evenings, but now I actually look forward to it because I get to see Amal and the amazing group of women who make every session enjoyable. Amal is one of a kind, love her energy and she lifts everyone up the moment we walk in.

Being new to Sharjah wasn’t easy, but she welcomed me with open arms and made me feel like family. This gym is more than just a place to work out, it’s a community I’m genuinely grateful to be part of. Highly recommend! Thank you Amal 😘😘

reviews.author: Zhra Mohamed
reviews.text: I've been to many sports clubs, but I've never enjoyed my time like I did here. There are such friendly people, and a lovely person like Amal, with her enthusiasm and positive energy that she spreads throughout the place, which made me love it. Love you Amoola😘🥰♥️

reviews.text: Thank you coach Amal for the amazing sessions. I'm so happy to join lately & I didn't only build muscles, I build lasting friendship. Keep the good work up 💪

reviews.author: SHAHFIZZ TRENDS
reviews.text: Really happy I joined Zahrat Al Amal Gym. The trainer are kind, workouts are varied, and the gym feels comfortable and encouraging for beginners too.

reviews.author: Mumthaz Hassan
reviews.text: My experience at the gym has been phenomenal. Their guidance has been valuable, and I've seen remarkable improvements in myself both physically and mentally. The gym offers a clean environment and a wide range of daily classes, keeping workouts exciting and varied. The availability of quality equipment further enhances the experience. The coach Amal’s motivational approach has boosted my confidence and kept me motivated throughout. I feel that I've made positive strides in my fitness journey. Overall, my time at the gym has been transformative, leaving me feeling better and more confident than ever before.
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you for the beautiful review I am glad that you benefited from the exercises.

reviews.author: Rizana Razak
reviews.text: Great gym with a very enthusiastic trainer🩷 Clean environment and daily classes with different activities. A good amount of gym equipment is available as well! Been visiting for almost two months now and I can say that, I feel much better exercising almost everyday. 🫶🏼

reviews.author: Yamama Ali
reviews.text: The best experiences of my life were when I visited this club. I tried every means to lose weight, to see myself from another perspective, and to achieve this achievement. I dreamed, dreamed, and tried, and they all failed. When I adapted to the gym , I felt something inside me with a will and determination, something that pushed me to make the most important decisions of my life. I lost thirty kilograms of weight and became a completely different person. My life has changed. I have become more diligent, optimistic and energetic, and all of this is thanks to the coach Amal, who helped me and always encouraged me. After this wonderful experience, I advise everyone to visit the Gym .

reviews.author: Rubab Mohd
reviews.text:
My confidence in myself has also increased since going to this gym as I’ve seen improvements in myself which I thought I might never see. The coach is amazing and motivative❤
In my opinion, there is nothing better then when leaving the gym and feeling like you did something which benefitted you..
So overall my  gym experience and the atmosphere has been pretty positive to say the least. I look better, I feel better, it’s been great for me.😍😍

reviews.author: Abdullah Alazam
reviews.text: I'm delighted that my mom has finally committed to going to the gym regularly because of the trainer and the enjoyable atmosphere. The gym offers a variety of classes including Zumba, aerobics, and belly dance, which has helped her maintain a consistent routine.

reviews.author: Rachel Kenton

Five stars all around!! ♥️♥️
